Full API spec:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: OOP Expense Management API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Laravel API for Out-of-Pocket expense management with user permissions and CSV batch upload
security:
  - oauth2: []
components:
  securitySchemes:
    oauth2:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: /oauth/token
          scopes: {}
paths:
  /api/v1/user-feature-permissions:
    get:
      summary: List user feature permissions
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
    post:
      summary: Grant feature permission to user
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                user_id:
                  type: integer
                feature_id:
                  type: integer
                manager_user_id:
                  type: integer
                  nullable: true
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Permission granted
        '403':
          description: Unauthorized to grant permission
  /api/v1/user-feature-permissions/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get specific permission
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
        '404':
          description: Permission not found
    put:
      summary: Update permission
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Permission updated
    delete:
      summary: Revoke permission
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Permission revoked
  /api/v1/pocket-expenses:
    get:
      summary: List user expenses
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [draft, submitted, approved, rejected]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
    post:
      summary: Create new expense
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                date:
                  type: string
                  format: date
                merchant_name:
                  type: string
                  maxLength: 180
                amount:
                  type: number
                  format: decimal
                currency:
                  type: string
                  pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$'
                expense_type:
                  type: integer
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Expense created
        '422':
          description: Validation error
  /api/v1/pocket-expenses/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get specific expense
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
        '404':
          description: Expense not found
    put:
      summary: Update expense
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Expense updated
    delete:
      summary: Delete expense
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Expense deleted
  /api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv:
    post:
      summary: Upload CSV file for batch expense processing
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                target_user_id:
                  type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: File uploaded and queued for processing
        '422':
          description: Validation error
Shared Knowledge: All models use Volopa legacy timestamp pattern with create_time and update_time DATETIME columns instead of Laravel's created_at/updated_at. Soft delete pattern uses deleted TINYINT(1) flag and delete_time DATETIME instead of Laravel's deleted_at. All controllers must use Oauth2UserClient middleware for authentication. Multi-tenant architecture requires client_id scoping on all queries. FXConversionService handles real-time currency conversion with 30-day lookback and commission calculations. CSV validation follows all-or-nothing principle - if any row fails validation, no expenses are created. ProcessExpenseUpload job runs on 'expense-processing' queue and processes uploads in batches of 100 records.
Anything UNCLEAR: Two aspects need clarification for complete implementation: 1) The notification mechanism for batch upload completion - whether to use email, in-app notifications, or a combination, as the platform notification infrastructure exists but the specific channel is undefined. 2) The exact query pattern for checking ClientFeatures model to verify if a client has OOP feature enabled (feature_id = 16), as the backing table structure for ClientFeatures is not documented in the YAML context. These are project-specific decisions that don't affect the core architecture but are needed for full feature completeness.
